\section*{Failed Runs}

\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{NPO beta=0.1, lr=5e-5, epochs=5, batch=24, r=8} (run 20260831-215752): model collapsed to repetitive degenerate output (e.g. \texttt{PAPAPA...}); all metrics 0.0. Cause: beta=0.1 amplifies NPO loss by $2/\\beta=20$ while lr=5e-5 is 8x the baseline 6.2e-6, gradient magnitude too high.
\end{itemize}
